api_endpoints_verified.notes: Generates audio in Hindi, deducts audition credit, caches result. Cached calls return cached=true
Returns audition_credits field for each user

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/credits correctly returns both generation_credits and audition_credits from user document
POST /api/tts/audition implements SHA256 caching based on voice_id:text combo, deducts credits only for new generations
Admin audition-credits endpoint correctly validates balance cannot go negative
Characters page audition panel text input is correctly empty by default (not pre-filled with placeholder)
VoiceGenerator correctly enforces character-only mode - no direct voice selection possible
Director's Notes label correctly renamed from Custom Style Instructions in sidebar
Download button successfully removed - only Push to Studio available

context_for_next_testing_agent: Major voice workflow refactor verified. Character-based workflow enforced - voice generation only through characters. Dual credit system (generation_credits + audition_credits) working. Audition endpoint uses Gemini and generates Hindi audio, results are cached. Create Character dialog simplified to name+voice only (no sliders). VoiceGenerator shows only character dropdown. 'Director's Notes' is the new label for style instructions in alternate engine mode. Download button removed, only Push to Studio remains. Admin can view/modify both credit types in Creators page.
